controlled_AB.sdk_io_interval: inputs_set + synchronous run + outputs_get + owned FP32 copy + release
controlled_AB.route_interval: complete route including checked view, finite checks and bridge hashes
controlled_AB.temperature_and_frequency_sampling: before/after each route; no clock or cooling control
controlled_AB.speed_scope: Observed short fixed-input co-resident-context comparison; not sustained throughput, full pose rate or P95. SDK IO sum excludes bridge hashes; instrumented route includes them.
controlled_AB.bridge_pointer_verification: Actual pointers retained in private raw receipt; same-pointer bridge check enforced at runtime and independently audited.
controlled_AB.frequency_limit: Read-only samples vary; alternating order is a short comparison, not controlled steady-state speed validation.
